sub_palette: east_asian (sinitic / Chinese register) backbone + mesoamerican (nahuatl / Aztec) substrate (cross-family blend, Sinitic-leaning)

blend.backbone: east_asian (sinitic / Chinese register: the Huangdi over wang and the five peerages, the Mandate of Heaven and the Confucian mandarin bureaucracy, the walled cheng river-cities, monosyllabic (C)(G)V(C) roots with -n/-ng codas and tonal contours, the celestial -di/-jun/-wang titles, the dragon and the celestial court)
blend.overlay: mesoamerican (nahuatl / Aztec: the teocalli sun-pyramid and the calendar-round, the calpolli wards and the chinampa, the jaguar-and-eagle war-cult, the feathered serpent, the jungle wealth of jade, obsidian, cacao, maize and quetzal-feather, the -tl/-tli absolutive and -tzin reverential, vigesimal counting)
blend.lean: Sinitic-heavy - a Celestial-Mandate dragon-court enthroned over the jungle pyramid-cities of the feathered serpent: the Huangdi and his mandarin order rule from the walled cheng, the Nahua jaguar-priesthood and the calpolli wards endure and serve beneath. The dragon and the feathered serpent, the celestial court and the sun-pyramid, the mandarin and the jaguar-priest - the Mandate of Heaven laid over the calendar-round.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_09 (Sinitic / Chinese, the Jinxian backbone) x BASE_10 (Nahuatl / Aztec, the Nahuan substrate). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: both parents are Civilized (the Sinitic Mandate realm + the Nahua Triple-Alliance theocracy), and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Huaztl is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Sinitic-Mesoamerican realm - the dragon and the feathered serpent, the celestial court and the sun-pyramid, the mandarin and the jaguar-priest. A Celestial-Mandate dragon-court that reached into the jungle, married the pyramid-cities of the feathered serpent, and set up the Huangdi and his mandarin bureaucracy over a Nahua war-cult: the Mandate of Heaven laid over the calendar-round. Backbone = Sinitic (the ruling celestial court, the Huangdi/wang/peerage register, the Mandate, the walled cheng, the Confucian mandarins); overlay/substrate = Nahuatl (the teocalli pyramid-temple, the calpolli wards, the jaguar-and-eagle war-cult, the jungle material wealth - jade, obsidian, cacao, maize, quetzal). Common-word lexicon is a SINGLE FUSED tongue (Nahuatl jungle/pyramid/material/staple roots + Sinitic rule/kin/court/land roots, all run through one Sinitic-shaped sound-law: tones and monosyllables dominant, the -tl/-tli absolutives clipped, clusters resolved); rank titles are English DISPLAY with Sinitic *_native forms beneath. NO approved foreign term applies (neither a Chinese nor a Mesoamerican rank is on the approved commonly-known list), so ALL display rulers are plain English and approved_foreign_terms_used is OMITTED. DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Sinitic canon-morphs PRIMARY, the Jinxian / family_east_asian sinitic set - Tuli-di, Aolan-jun; Nahuatl morphs SECONDARY, the Nahuan / family_mesoamerican nahuatl set - Tolratl, Marakatl), recognizably the same powers under two faces, never real Chinese/Aztec gods. The Mandate of Heaven (Tianming) legitimizes the throne; the calendar-round and the offered heart bind the jungle wards beneath. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (the dragon-court mandarins keep the Lawful celestial order; the jaguar war-cult of the substrate leans to the Chaotic blood-sun; worship assigned by current alignment).

phonology.palette: Sinitic (Chinese) backbone - monosyllabic morphemes; syllable (C)(G)V(C) with only -n/-ng codas; tonal contours (unmarked in data); NO consonant clusters; the retroflex/palatal initials zh/ch/sh/x/q/j; surname(1) + given(1-2); celestial titles -di (emperor), -jun (lord), -wang (king) - meeting a Nahuatl substrate: the absolutive -tl/-tli and reverential -tzin, the consonants tl, tz, ch, x (sh), hu/uh (w), the place-suffixes -tlan/-tepec/-co, the jungle and pyramid vocabulary, vigesimal counting. Per the CSV: vibrant vowels with tonal contours, the Nahua material-roots clipped to fit the tight Sinitic monosyllable and the celestial tone-court; grammar is SVO with isolating vigesimal counting (the Sinitic word-order and the Nahua base-20 number-system married, no case-stacking). Theophoric on the Sinitic morph-stems (Tuli-, Aolan-, Gaidun-) with Nahua deity-variants beneath (Tolra-, Maraka-).
phonology.phonotactics: tight Sinitic monosyllables (C)(G)V(C), finals -n/-ng only, NO clusters; the Nahua -tl/-tli/-tzin endings clipped away and the -tl/-tz clusters resolved to a bare initial (tl > t or l, tz > z/c) to fit the Sinitic syllable; initials incl. zh/ch/sh/x/q/j; tonal contours distinctive; surname(1) + given(1-2) over -tepec/-tlan substrate toponyms re-cut to Sinitic shape.

sound_changes: Nahuatl absolutive -tl/-tli and reverential -tzin dropped: the root is clipped to a bare Sinitic monosyllable (tepetl>tepe>te, cuahuitl>cua, itztli>itz>i)
Nahuatl -tl/-tz clusters resolved to fit the no-cluster Sinitic syllable: tl- > t or l, tz- > z or c, the -uh/hu glide > -u/w; only -n/-ng survive as codas
Nahua polysyllables compressed to one or two Sinitic syllables under tonal stress; the long Nahuatl place-words re-cut (atoyatl>ya river-root, teocalli>teo-cheng pyramid-city)
Sinitic tones and monosyllabic shape imposed on every root from either parent; surname(1)+given(1-2) order kept; vigesimal counting (the Nahua base-20) carried on Sinitic number-words

retain the Sinitic finals -n/-ng, the zh/ch/sh/x/q/j initials and the celestial -di/-jun/-wang, plus a few audible Nahua signatures (teo- divine, -tepe mountain, quetz- feather); very short Nahua roots take a Sinitic vowel to scan
fusion_rules.source_tilt: jungle/pyramid/material/staple words from Nahuatl roots (the substrate works the jungle and the chinampa - the teocalli pyramid, jade, obsidian, cacao, maize, quetzal-feather); rule/kin/court/land/quality/war words from Sinitic roots (the ruling celestial-court register); every root then filtered to one Sinitic-shaped phonology (tones, monosyllables, no clusters) so the split is invisible at the surface - it all sounds like one tongue

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Nahuatl jungle/pyramid/material/staple roots + Sinitic rule/kin/court/land roots, all run through one Sinitic-shaped sound-law (the -tl/-tli/-tzin absolutives clipped, clusters resolved to the no-cluster Sinitic syllable, tones and monosyllabic shape imposed); portmanteaus mark the married institutions where the dragon-court and the feathered-serpent pyramid wedded. One language - Sinitic-shaped, Nahuatl-substrated - not a slash list.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Sinitic mandarin nobility carry the clan-surname (xing) first then a given name, with generation-names within a zu (lineage) and an examination-rank; the Nahua substrate keep the calpolli (ward) name and a calendar-day name with -tzin reverential for the honored; the throne fuses both - a Huangdi who carries a Sinitic xing and holds the Mandate over the teocalli-cities and the calpolli wards.

gendered_endings.male: auspicious martial/virtue meanings (Sinitic court); a calendar-day or deed name + -tzin reverential (Nahua substrate)
gendered_endings.female: flower/jade/virtue meanings (Sinitic court); Cihua- (woman) or flower-day name + -tzin (Nahua substrate)

morphology.compounding_rule: Sinitic feature/quality + type juxtaposition ([surname]+[given]; Jin-cheng golden-city, Bei-guan north-pass) layered over Nahua place-compounds re-cut to Sinitic shape (Huei-tepe great-mountain, Quetz-tlan feather-place): the capital Huaztlan (Hua-ztlan, the cathay-of-the-jungle, the dragon-serpent river-land), Da-teomiao (the great sun-pyramid temple), Jin-cheng (the golden city).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Sinitic celestial-court over the Nahua pyramid-cities: the Huangdi and his wang-kin at the crown holding the Mandate, the peerage-governors over the cheng-provinces, the Confucian mandarin order of officials; the Nahua tlatoque city-kings, the pipiltin nobility, the calpolli wards and the jaguar war-cult serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Sinitic ladder, ascending, with the Nahua pyramid-city substrate co-titles beneath. Nan (baron) barony; Dudu (frontier military command) march; Bo (count) county; Hou (marquis) duchy; Gong (duke / prince of the blood) principality; Wang (king) kingdom over a Wangguo; Huangdi (emperor) empire over the Diguo, holding the Mandate of Heaven (Tianming). The conquered jungle-cities keep their Nahua tlatoani (city-king of an altepetl), tecuhtli (lord) and the calpolli ward-heads beneath the Sinitic crown; the Confucian mandarin shi-officials govern, the Nahua tlamacazqui jaguar-priests tend the teocalli, both standing in and beside the ladder. NO approved foreign term applies (neither the Sinitic nor the Nahua ranks are on the approved commonly-known list), so ALL display rulers are plain English; the Sinitic *_native forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY.
title_ladder.heir: Taizi (the crown prince; the heir) / Shizi (heir of a wang or peer)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are plain ENGLISH - NO approved foreign term applies here (neither the Sinitic nor the Nahua ranks are on the approved commonly-known list), so there is no foreign display term and approved_foreign_terms_used is omitted. The *_native conlang forms (Sinitic, with Nahua co-titles) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Sinitic mandarin ruling stock carry the clan-surname (xing) first then a given name (ming), with a courtesy-name (zi) for adults and an examination-rank; the Nahua substrate carry a calendar-day name + an earned deed/war-name and a calpolli (ward), with -tzin reverential for the honored; order surname-first for the Sinitic court, day-name-first for the Nahua substrate, the court register prevailing at the throne.
surname_source: Nahua calendar-day name or earned deed/war-name
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Sinitic mandarin nobility carry xing + ming, a courtesy-name (zi) and an examination-rank; the Nahua city-folk carry a calendar-day name + ward (calpolli) and lordly -tzin titles for the pipiltin.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Sinitic names invoke the celestial powers' epithets and the Mandate rather than the god-name directly (Tian-en, heaven's grace; a temple-name honoring Tuli-di) on the Sinitic morph-stems; the Nahua substrate invokes the powers + an element - Teo- (divine), -tzin (revered): Tolra-tzin, Teo-Maraka, calendar-and-power day-names on the Nahua morph-stems (Tolratl, Marakatl).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Sinitic canon-morphs PRIMARY (the Jinxian / family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic: Tuli-di, Aolan-jun, Gaidun-di, Numeng-jun, Lianta-mu), Nahuatl morphs SECONDARY (the Nahuan / family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.nahuatl: Tolratl, Marakatl, Gaiantli, Numenatl, Rialtzin), recognizably the same powers under two faces, never real Chinese/Aztec gods (no Tian-shang-di, Guan-yu, Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca, Huitzilopochtli). Shared pantheon, two registers married. A Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven laid over the calendar-round: the One (Aiteng, the Nahua face Aiternatl) presides as Highest Heaven; the Lawful powers are the celestial officials (the -di emperors and -jun lords of the dragon-court); the jungle war-cult of the substrate leans to the Chaotic blood-sun (Marakatl). The Mandate (Tianming) legitimizes the throne, the calendar-round and the offered heart bind the calpolli wards. Worship vs demonization follows the culture's CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment).
religion.the_one: Aiteng (< Aeternus; the Nahua face Aiternatl) - the Highest Heaven, the source of the Mandate, served not petitioned by the dragon-court; named the Tyrant-Sun by the Chaotic jaguar-cult of the substrate

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tuli-di (Nahua Tolratl) - the Sun-Justice Emperor, lord of the celestial register; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Aolan-jun (Nahua Orlantzin) - the iron Lord of oath and war
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaidun-di (Nahua Gaiantli) - the Earth Emperor, lord of mountains and the chinampa
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numeng-jun (Nahua Numenatl) - the Sage Lord of the winds, the feathered-serpent wind
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Lianta-mu (Nahua Rialtzin) - the Mother of Mercy, the Lady of Waters
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maluo (Nahua Marakatl) - the War-Fire Marshal, the Blood-Sun of the jaguar-cult; chief of the Chaotic powers

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiteng the Highest Heaven, Tuli-di the just Sun-Emperor, Aolan-jun of the sworn war, Lianta-mu the merciful - keeps the Confucian rites and the Mandate of Heaven, and names the Chaotic powers the demon-marshals (mo / Nahua tzitzimitl), warded; the dragon-throne and the celestial register bind the realm.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: honors the zu-ancestors (the deified worthy officials of the celestial register) and the Nahua calpolli fore-spirits, and the local earth-and-grain, river and mountain powers; the great powers invoked at the teomiao-pyramid and the ancestral Ci situationally; the calendar-round and the harvest kept.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - chief among them Maluo / Marakatl, the War-Fire, the Blood-Sun that must be fed by the offered heart - and names the One (Aiteng) and the Lawful powers the cold tyrant-gods of the soft; the jaguar war-cult and the skull-rack atop the teomiao the altars, the calendar-round binding the wards to the blood-sun.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded by the dragon-court as the demon-marshals (mo) outside the celestial order or as the Nahua tzitzimitl star-demons, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maluo the War-Fire Marshal (Nahua Marakatl the Blood-Sun); Vacidus -> Wuci the Devourer (Nahua Wakitl the Hungering-Dark); Lusanto -> Lusan the Coin-Serpent (Nahua Lusankoatl the Hoard-Serpent).

clergy_ladder.9: Tianshi (celestial master) / Hueyi Teopixqui (Nahua great sacrificer)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Miao (Sinitic temple) or the Teomiao (the sun-pyramid god-house atop the great pyramid) of [power]: 'the Miao of Tuli-di', 'the Teomiao of Maluo', crowned by the skull-rack; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: deified worthy officials and heroes enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao; and the fallen jaguar-and-eagle warriors and offered captives who become sun-feeding companions, honored at the teomiao and the skull-rack.
